workstreams.name: Stakeholder interviews
workstreams.answers: Where do the people who handle and oversee property and health claims say settlement time is lost, and why?
activities: Interview the people who handle property and health claims
Interview the COO, Head of Claims and Board members
Synthesize interview pain points by claims line

workstreams.name: Time & satisfaction baseline
workstreams.answers: What are current average settlement time and customer satisfaction for property and health claims?
activities: Measure settlement time from operational claims data
Measure customer satisfaction with customer feedback data
Agree the measurement definitions with the Head of Claims

workstreams.name: Motor lean program review
workstreams.answers: What did the 2024 lean program change for motor claims, and what carries over to property and health?
activities: Review lean program documents and motor handling-time data
Interview those who ran the program and motor handlers
Test which motor changes apply to property and health

workstreams.name: Settlement delay causes
workstreams.answers: At which settlement steps do property and health claims lose time, and what causes the loss?
activities: Map property and health settlement steps with the handlers
Measure waiting and rework time per step from claims data
Trace the causes of delay and rank them by time lost

workstreams.name: Operating model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models fit property and health claims, and how do they compare on settlement time and satisfaction?
activities: Define candidate claims operating models for both lines
Compare options on delay causes addressed and satisfaction
Prepare the option comparison for the first workshop

workstreams.name: Chosen model design
workstreams.answers: Does the chosen option cut settlement time for property and health without lowering satisfaction below current levels?
activities: Detail structure, roles and governance of the chosen model
Detail property and health designs with the line leaders
Test the design against both success criteria

workstreams.name: Transition plan
workstreams.answers: What transition steps move the insurer to the chosen model, and what must the Board decide?
activities: Sequence steps that work with the current claims IT system
Define change actions for claims staff and line leaders
List the decisions the Board must take

workstreams.name: Report and Board readout
workstreams.answers: Do the final report and Board presentation give the Board what it needs to decide?
activities: Draft the final report from diagnostic and design findings
Prepare the Board presentation
Review drafts with the COO and Head of Claims
